QuestInfo.name: Whose Job Is It Anyway?
QuestInfo.0: #b#p1092002##k is looking at you with newfound respect. Is it because of how you handled the starfishes? You should see if there's anything else you can do.
QuestInfo.1: #b#p1094000##k is supposed to keep the monsters in check, but he's obviously slacking off. Baine wants you to make sure #b#p1094000##k gets back to work!
QuestInfo.2: #b#p1094000##k says it's not HIS job. Then whose job is it?

0.0: If only #b#p1094000##k weren't slackin' off, I wouldn'ta had this problem to start with...
0.1: #b#p1094000##k's the one who's supposed to keep the Starfish in check! Why don't you give him a visit and knock some sense into him?

yes.0: #b#p1094000##k's probably lousing about at #r#m120000000##k. Remember, it's his fault you had'ta fight all them Starfish!

no.0: Hey, you want to keep doing his job for him, be my guest!

1.0: Who are you? What? No, I ain't slacking off! #b#p1092002##k's way off the mark here!

yes.0: I mean, yeah, I'm supposed to keep the monsters in line, but somethin' came up! I asked #b#p1092004##k to take over for me. Blame him, not me!

npc.0: #b#p1094000##k's probably hanging around #r#m120000000#. Teach that boy a lesson!
